settings.scope: Pure N2 in a rigid isothermal porous column, fixed-pressure ideal reservoirs at both ends. Explicit bath heat to sustain fixed T; compare long-time Darcy-Knudsen through-flow with the exact steady pressure potential. No reaction, thermal history, or real-brick material claim.
settings.entropy_definition: Relative ideal-gas storage entropy -R*n*ln(c/c_ref), with declared molar entropy zero at c_ref and this fixed T. Stream entropy per mole is -R ln(c/c_ref). Constant molar U reference is declared; h=u+RT. Bath heat into each cell is -RT*dN/dt. Include material reservoir stream entropy plus the opposite bath heat/T in combined entropy accounting.
settings.physical_input_classification: Declared straight-capillary-bundle pore geometry; kappa=porosity*radius^2/8. Source-qualified approximate N2 viscosity and effective Knudsen diffusion. Reservoir pressures and fixed T are prescribed operating conditions. Zero molar U is a reference gauge at one T for this nonreacting single species, not an absolute formation energy or a zero heat capacity.

scope: Static original pure-gas flux and open bath/stream identities, plus exact steady center and cell-average comparison. No dynamic qualification yet.
